head: working-tree
subject: gRPC xDS bootstrap server feature wiring
change: runtime.Options.applyServerFeatures copies the selected bootstrap server's four feature booleans into the controller options: ignore_resource_deletion, fail_on_data_errors, trusted_xds_server and resource_timer_is_transient_error. Controller.applyServerFeatures also updates a live controller's options and listener policy, so it can be called again after failover selects a server with a different feature set. The helpers make the documented bootstrap-to-runtime flow explicit and avoid silently dropping a security-relevant feature such as trusted_xds_server.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/runtime/constructor_tests.zig parses a bootstrap document with one feature-bearing server and one plain server, checks that applyServerFeatures sets each runtime option, then applies both servers to a live controller and verifies the controller and listener policy are updated and cleared.

focused_gate.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='bootstrap server features' -Dtest-filter='xDS runtime' -Dtest-filter='bootstrap' --summary all

notes: ControlPlane.server() returns the selected bootstrap server. Call Controller.applyServerFeatures again after failoverWithDeadline so the live policy follows the new server. RDS snapshots created before the change keep the trust policy they were built with; later publications use the new one.
